name: Valmar's Pit Trap
disable: DC 22 Survival check (trained) to reinforce the dirt so it's safe to walk on, or DC 18 Thievery check (trained) to collapse the trap from a safe distance
reset: Creatures can still fall into the pit, but the soil must be replaced for the trap to become hidden again.

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps onto any space in the dotted area on the map, or at least 30 pounds of pressure is put on the area

---

Effect The ground gives way. The triggering creature falls 20 feet down the hole, taking 10 bludgeoning and landing Prone in area E10. A creature can Grab an Edge to avoid falling.

text: The ground here is made of loosely packed soil that, when stepped upon, collapses.
